failureReason: The model attempted to implement the prefetch URL data feature but only partially completed it. While it correctly added `prefetch={true}` to the category links in app/page.tsx, it failed to: (1) add `use cache` directives to cache the category data, (2) enable Partial Prefetching in next.config.ts, and (3) properly structure the cache scope around the product fetching logic. The EVAL tests show 3 failures: missing Partial Prefetching configuration, missing `use cache` scope, and incomplete per-link prefetch of category data.
